newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 30.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Ruling Nationalist Party, leading opposition Democratic Progressive Party to discuss constitutional amendment issues on June 1
Anti-smoking groups to launch campaign on May 31 against smoking in all public areas, including hotels, restaurants, department stores
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Four hundred scholars endorse statements opposing "dual leadership system" as proposed in constitutional amendments under debate
President Lee Teng-hui holds second senior leaders' meeting to discuss law and order problems
LIBERTY TIMES - First ethnic Chinese to graduate from U.S. military academy at West Point
COMMERCIAL TIMES - China to build petrochemical complex in in southern costal city of Meizhou
50.2 pct of Taiwan executives oppose (Taiwan's) cautious investment policy toward China
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Provincial assembly approves privatisation of "big three" state-run banks
Power outage costs (southern Taiwan) petrochemical plants at least T$300 million; fire, explosion hit north Taiwan refinery
